Install the package together with its peers:

```sh
npm install @sjtu-ai4math/snl-basics katex react react-dom
```

Pin an exact Basics version in a real consuming project. Before upgrading, inspect `MIGRATION.md`, schema constants, and the packed export/type gates. A published version and a newer repository commit may differ.

Use the package root for a React syntax-tree view. Prefer the documented `/core`, `/runtime`, or `/hover` subpath when it matches your integration; do not deep-import an implementation file. Complete Entry cards use `/entry` so the root path does not acquire Markdown processing.

Load KaTeX CSS and the matching Basics stylesheet once. A tree-only app imports `/style.css`; an Entry app imports `/entry/style.css`. These are actual package assets, not magic CSS injected by a query driver. Preserve required fonts/assets in the bundler or exporter.

For a full local example, use `examples/basic-demo`:

```sh
cd examples/basic-demo
npm install
npm run dev
```

Its lifecycle builds the local package through public imports. It proves source-linked integration when exercised, not the bytes currently served by npm.
